أنتدي (form VII)
# أَنْتَدِي (ʔantadī) /ʔan.ta.diː/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْتَدَى (intadā)
# أَنْتَدِيَ (ʔantadiya) /ʔan.ta.di.ja/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَدَى (intadā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
